description: This file defines the GrainPropertiesResolver class, which is responsible for resolving GrainProperties for GrainType values within the Orleans framework. It interacts with the cluster manifest provider to retrieve grain metadata.

classes.name: GrainPropertiesResolver
classes.description: A class that resolves GrainProperties for given GrainType values by querying the cluster manifest provider.

methods.name: GetGrainProperties
methods.description: Retrieves the GrainProperties for a specified GrainType, returning an empty set if not found.

methods.name: TryGetGrainProperties
methods.description: Attempts to find GrainProperties for a given GrainType, returning true if successful and false otherwise.
